hn.originalTitle: Pizza history: AI agent's cardless purchase is a first for UK
hn.sourceOriginalText:
Comment 1: Seems like every new payment method gets inaugurated with a pizza (just ask Bitcoin)

Comment 2: Over the past week, I have been looking for an affordable handheld wood plane. So let's look at this quote: > the first step toward mass adoption by the public of a technology that would fundamentally change purchasing habits. ... This is possibly the last Black Friday as we know it I'm using ChatGPT, Sol 6.1. My requirements are fairly simple: a 45 degree blade, approx Stanley #5 style (so about 35cm long), I would prefer wooden handles but not required, must be affordable for a 'first' plane, not an expensive expert's tool, so sub-100-euros: find me one in a store I can order locally (Estonia, known for its online tech in general, you order everything online.) It turns out finding one that length at that price is hard. But the experience of AI-assisted shopping has been infuriating and frustrating. It kept circling back to other planes than my requirements. It frequently recommended s.

Comment 3: hand planes are a purchase that is highly impacted by preference. pizzas are not.

Comment 4: Or: pizzas can be customized. Hand planes cannot.

hn.originalTitle: Muxlio: Durable workflow orchestration for AI agents and tools
hn.sourceOriginalText:
Muxlio

Build a workflow. Let your agents run it.

Muxlio is a durable workflow coordinator for multi-step work across AI agents and shell tools. Your assistant authors an immutable plan; the coordinator runs it as a durable run you can follow in the bundled UI or through MCP after setup.

Claude · Codex · Cursor · Kiro · Antigravity (authoring) · command-line tools

Plans, runs, and workers

Use Muxlio when work needs dependent steps, verification, retries, or hand-offs—not for one-off answers in the client. You or your assistant authors a workflow ; Muxlio compiles it to an immutable plan and executes a run on the coordinator . Steps run on workers through adapters (agent CLIs, remote A2A, command , and others).

Setup ports and MCP clients: Setup defaults . Architecture: overview and how it works .

How I use Muxlio to implement features

I use this recipe to develop Muxlio itself. The workflow handles one feature at a time and runs the repository’s build and tests before creating a local commit.

Build the workflow with your assistant

Describe the steps and checks you want. Your assistant authors and validates a workflow, then starts a run with your inputs. Check the plan before starting the run.

Implement, review, test, fix

An agent implements the feature. A review step inspects and improves the change. Build and test commands run. If a check fails, an agent gets the failure report, fixes it, and the checks run again.

After checks pass, the recipe creates a local commit and moves to the next feature. Inspect the diff, review notes, test output, and run history. You decide whether to push.

I run feature work overnight.

I run Muxlio on a Mac mini and start workflows through my assistant. In the morning, I check the commits and reports. If a run stopped, I read the error and decide what to do next. The chat can be closed while it runs.

You choose where it runs: your workstation, another computer, or a server. Keep the execution machine running and use the UI or your assistant to check progress.

Install Muxlio, then start the service.

Use Homebrew on macOS or Linux. It installs the CLI, adapters, UI, and MCP server without a manual checkout.

brew tap Muxlio/muxlio brew install --HEAD Muxlio/muxlio/muxlio muxlio version Then, from the workspace you want to use:

muxlio init --client kiro --scope project muxlio service start init prepares workspace configuration, credentials, and agent instructions; service start runs the coordinator and worker. Default ports and MCP client rules match Start Muxlio → Setup defaults .

Verify stdio MCP with the MCP guide when appropriate, then ask your assistant to build a workflow for your task, validate it, and show you the plan before running it. You do not need Muxlio's source repository to use the installed service. The worker needs the files and tools your workflow uses.

For the feature example, the workflow and its verification commands are in the implement-features recipe . Use it as a starting point and adapt the steps, agents, and checks to your work. The Docker Sandbox walkthrough shows two dependent features running against one branch in a private clone with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and command execution available on the sbx worker. Select localhost for the host checkout or sandbox for the Docker checkout. Follow a run at or ask your assistant for its status.

Guides and reference

Build your own workflows with the CLI and SDK reference ↗
hn.titleZh: Muxlio：適用於 AI 代理和工具的持久工作流程編排

hn.sourceTextZh:
Muxlio 建置工作流程。讓你的代理人來運行它。 Muxlio 是一個持久的工作流程協調器，用於跨 AI 代理和 shell 工具的多步驟工作。你的助手製定了一個不可改變的計劃；協調器將其作為持久運行運行，您可以在捆綁的 UI 中或在設置後通過 MCP 進行跟踪。 Claude · Codex · Cursor · Kiro · Antigravity（創作） · 命令列工具 計劃、運行和工作人員 當工作需要相關步驟、驗證、重試或交接時，請使用 Muxlio，而不是在客戶端中提供一次性答案。您或您的助手編寫工作流程； Muxlio 將其編譯為不可變計劃並在協調器上執行運行。步驟透過適配器（代理 CLI、遠端 A2A、命令 等）在工作人員上運行。設定連接埠和 MCP 用戶端：設定預設值。架構：概述及其工作原理。我如何使用 Muxlio 實作功能 我使用這個秘籍來開發 Muxlio 本身。此工作流程一次處理一項功能，並在建立本地提交之前運行儲存庫的建置和測試。與您的助手一起建立工作流程 描述您想要的步驟和檢查。您的助理創作並驗證工作流程，然後根據您的輸入開始運作。開始跑步前檢查計畫。實施、審查、測試、修復 代理實施該功能。審核步驟檢查並改進變更。運行建置和測試命令。

如果檢查失敗，代理程式會取得失敗報告並修復它，然後再次執行檢查。檢查通過後，配方將建立本地提交並移至下一個功能。檢查差異、檢視註解、測試輸出和運行歷史記錄。你決定是否推。我連夜進行專題工作。我在 Mac mini 上運行 Muxlio，並透過我的助手啟動工作流程。早上，我檢查提交和報告。如果運行停止，我會閱讀錯誤並決定下一步該做什麼。聊天運行時可以關閉。您可以選擇它的運作位置：您的工作站、另一台電腦或伺服器。保持執行機運作並使用 UI 或助理檢查進度。安裝 Muxlio，然後啟動服務。在 macOS 或 Linux 上使用 Homebrew。它無需手動簽出即可安裝 CLI、適配器、UI 和 MCP 伺服器。然後，從要使用的工作區： muxlio init --client kiro --scope project muxlio service start init 準備工作區設定、憑證和代理程式指令；服務啟動執行協調器和工作器。預設連接埠和 MCP 用戶端規則與啟動 Muxlio → 設定預設值相符。在適當的時候使用 MCP 指南驗證 stdio MCP，然後要求您的助手為您的任務建立工作流程，對其進行驗證，並在運行之前向您展示計劃。

您不需要 Muxlio 的來源儲存庫即可使用已安裝的服務。工作人員需要您的工作流程所使用的文件和工具。對於功能範例，工作流程及其驗證命令位於 Implement-features Recipe 中。使用它作為起點，並根據您的工作調整步驟、代理和檢查。 Docker Sandbox 演練展示了針對私有複製中的一個分支運行的兩個相關功能，其中 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 和 sbx 工作執行緒上可用的命令執行。選擇 localhost 作為主機簽出，或選擇沙盒作為 Docker 簽出。追蹤跑步或詢問您的助手其狀態。指南和參考 使用 CLI 和 SDK 參考建立您自己的工作流程 ↗

hn.originalTitle: Show HN: AI agents can now call you
hn.sourceOriginalText:
Your AI agents can now call you

We added what I believe is a neat feature. In an effort to make OnAir a versatile communication tool: your AI agents can now use it.

Paste this to your agent:

Call me on onair.io/your-name if you need me. How it works: the agent installs nothing. I am paranoid about installing external services, and so should you. So the agent (Claude Code, Codex, any script) reads onair.io/your-name.md and calls you with plain curl : start a call, say, listen, end. That is less efficient than a native tool, I can be convinced to re-visit. Under the hood: GPTLive as a bridge. The agent's text becomes a voice on your phone, and your voice becomes text for the agent.

hn.originalTitle: LLM agents work for their parent companies, not for you
hn.sourceOriginalText:
LLM agents work for their parent companies, not for you | Michael Harley

In the evenings after work, I will often sit out back on the porch and do some phone rotting. That usually takes the form of me just flipping through reels on Instagram, allowing the algorithm to take me where it may. I usually pair this with a healthy tumbler of rum or bourbon. I'm turning my brain off after work, and I'm just having a good time on the internet. The kids might call it dopamine maxxing? Hell, I don't know. Who gives a shit about what those assholes would call it?

Anywho, I often encounter songs I really really like, and I would like to listen and discover more of please. Instagram makes it hard for me to connect with the band outside of their platform. I was trying to make this connection manually myself at first. I would just email myself a reel from my phone. Then when I'm back on the sofa and in the mood to track down new music, I'd open the reels and do my best to search on Bandcamp or YouTube or try to figure out if some of these musicians had a way to buy music from them. Very few do these days. They send you their Spotify link or send you to their TikTok page. I don't want to do any of that. I'd like to trade US dollars in exchange for some m.

So, I used Claude Code to build a skill that does this for me. It opens the Instagram reel and attempts to identify the artist and song. It then tries to determine if the artists have a Bandcamp page so I can purchase the songs I want, and if it finds one, it gives me the URL so I can click it to complete the trade I want. I want to buy music from artists who make music I like. That's a fair and wholesome endeavor, I feel, but this recently stopped working.

It turns out Bandcamp added a challenge on their search API page. Ah bummer. No worries, that was an unpublished workaround anyway. As I was mulling over this discovery, the robot went on to explain that it would not help me work around the challenge. cue Nick Young question marks

Well, that led me down a whole nother rabbit hole, which is turning into this post. There's another branch of my skill that attempts to locate the same song from the Instagram reel on YouTube, and it'll download the song to my computer if I ask.

So let me get this straight. The robot, which is my robot that I pay a pretty penny for, will not attempt to work around the challenge at Bandcamp so that I can more easily connect with bands to complete a sale, but it will download the YouTube song, which doesn't send any money to the band or anyone ???

This is the real danger of the frontier AI models. Not that it won't help me hack Bandcamp [1] , but that this model doesn't really work for us. Well, they do, but only insofar as Anthropic or OpenAI or whoever else allows them to. In this case, Anthropic is trying to ensure that people can't use their models for evil. I'm not trying to do evil. I'm actually trying to do good! I want to buy something from a small artist on the internet. That's basically the most wholesome thing a person can do on the internet!

Have no doubt, dear reader, these companies want to dominate. They want to capture the market. They want all the money. It'll be the same march to enshittification that happened with Google. A bunch of nerds who built something cool sold out, and it turned into just another business that decided to remove its don't be evil mantra.

Right now, I think the robots are providing real information to the best of their ability, but I think it's only a matter of time until we must wonder if the answers they're providing are real answers that the robot found, or if they're weighted answers Anthropic put there because a company gave it enough money for product placement. I want to know the best robot vacuum according to old reddit or other trusted sources like Wirecutter, weighed and measured according to what I, and thus my robot agent, think are important requirements. I don't want to know which robot vacuum parent multinational conglomerate has a large ad budget.

And it's not just ads. If Anthropic can tell its model not to work around a challenge, then it can tell its model to do whatever the US government tells it to do, including not helping people download copyrighted music. It does that some now, but it's easy to slip the noose on that. For now.

This is the reason I want a local model that runs in my homelab. My robot should work for me and have my best interests in mind, not the interests of US corporate copyright holders. I plan to study up on what "open models" even m
hn.titleZh: LLM 代理人為他們的母公司工作，而不是為您工作
hn.summaryZh: 這篇來自 Hacker News 工程師討論，重點和 LLM / Agent 有關。適合用來快速了解社群正在討論的實作方向、工具變化或使用心得。
hn.sourceTextZh:
LLM 代理人為他們的母公司工作，而不是為您工作 |邁克爾·哈雷 (Michael Harley) 晚上下班後，我經常坐在門廊後面玩手機。這通常是我在 Instagram 上翻閱捲軸，讓演算法帶我去任何可能的地方。我通常將其與一杯健康的朗姆酒或波本威士忌搭配。下班後我會關掉大腦，只是在網路上玩得很開心。孩子可能會稱之為多巴胺最大化？見鬼，我不知道。誰在乎那些混蛋會怎麼稱呼它？不管怎樣，我經常會遇到我非常喜歡的歌曲，我想聽並發現更多。 Instagram 讓我很難在他們的平台之外與樂團建立聯繫。我一開始嘗試自己手動建立此連接。我只會用手機給自己發一份捲軸。然後，當我回到沙發並有心情尋找新音樂時，我會打開捲軸並盡力在 Bandcamp 或 YouTube 上搜索，或者嘗試弄清楚其中一些音樂家是否有辦法從他們那裡購買音樂。如今很少人這樣做。他們向您發送 Spotify 連結或將您發送至他們的 TikTok 頁面。我不想做任何事。我想用美元換一些米。因此，我使用 Claude Code 建立了一項可以幫助我完成此任務的技能。它會打開 Instagram 捲軸並嘗試識別藝術家和歌曲。

然後，它會嘗試確定藝術家是否有 Bandcamp 頁面，以便我可以購買我想要的歌曲，如果找到，它會向我提供 URL，以便我可以單擊它來完成我想要的交易。我想從製作我喜歡的音樂的藝術家那裡購買音樂。我認為這是一項公平且有益健康的努力，但最近它不再起作用了。結果 Bandcamp 在他們的搜尋 API 頁面上添加了一個挑戰。啊，真糟糕。不用擔心，無論如何，這是一個未發布的解決方法。當我思考這個發現時，機器人繼續解釋說它不會幫助我解決這個挑戰。提示尼克楊問號好吧，這讓我陷入了另一個兔子洞，這就是這篇文章。我的技能的另一個分支是嘗試從 YouTube 上的 Instagram 影片中找到同一首歌曲，如果我要求，它就會將該歌曲下載到我的電腦上。讓我說清楚。這個機器人，這是我花了不少錢買的機器人，不會嘗試解決 Bandcamp 的挑戰，以便我可以更輕鬆地與樂隊聯繫以完成銷售，但它會下載 YouTube 歌曲，這不會向樂隊或任何人發送任何錢???這是前沿人工智能模型的真正危險。並不是說它不能幫助我破解 Bandcamp [1] ，而是這個模型並不真正適合我們。嗯，他們確實這麼做了，但僅限於 Anthropic 或 OpenAI 或任何其他允許他們這麼做的人。

在這種情況下，Anthropic 試圖確保人們不能利用他們的模型來作惡。我並不是想作惡。其實我是想做好事！我想在網路上買一個小藝術家的東西。這基本上是一個人可以在網路上做的最有益健康的事情！親愛的讀者，毫無疑問，這些公司想要佔據主導地位。他們想要佔領市場。他們想要所有的錢。這將是與Google發生的同樣的向實事化的進軍。一群書呆子建造的一些很酷的東西被賣光了，它變成了另一家決定取消「不作惡」口號的企業。現在，我認為機器人正在盡其所能提供真實的信息，但我認為這只是時間問題，我們必須懷疑它們提供的答案是否是機器人找到的真實答案，或者它們是否是人類放在那裡的加權答案，因為一家公司給了它足夠的錢用於植入式廣告。我想根據舊的 reddit 或其他值得信賴的來源（如 Wirecutter）了解最好的機器人吸塵器，並根據我和我的機器人代理認為的重要要求進行稱重和測量。我不想知道哪家機器人吸塵器母公司跨國集團擁有大量廣告預算。這不僅僅是廣告。

如果 Anthropic 可以告訴其模型不要解決挑戰，那麼它就可以告訴其模型執行美國政府要求其執行的任何操作，包括不幫助人們下載受版權保護的音樂。現在它確實做到了一些，但很容易套上套索。目前。這就是我想要一個在我的家庭實驗室中運行的本地模型的原因。我的機器人應該為我工作，並考慮到我的最大利益，而不是美國公司版權所有者的利益。我打算研究一下「開放模型」到底是什麼

hn.originalTitle: Show HN: An agent skill that optimizes code with falsifiable hypotheses
hn.sourceOriginalText:
Agentic Algorithm Engineering (AAE)

Agents that optimize your code like an algorithm engineer: a falsifiable hypothesis before every experiment, correctness checked after every change, one reviewable patch per accepted change, and a PDF report of the whole session.

A skill for Claude Code and Codex, from the Algorithm Engineering Group at Heidelberg University.

Results on established open-source codes

Every kept change was checked against the original output.

How it works: the Algorithm Engineering cycle

Algorithm Engineering is a cycle of design, analysis, implementation and experiment, driven by falsifiable hypotheses. AAE hands this cycle to an autonomous agent. During setup you agree with the agent on the benchmark, the metric, the correctness assertions and the budget; then it runs on its own.

A falsifiable hypothesis: "changing X will improve the metric by roughly Z, because ..."

Predict direction and size of the effect before measuring, from profiling and analysis.

A minimal change, committed to Git, with the correctness assertions checked.

Run the benchmark; keep the change only if it is better and still correct, otherwise revert.

From the report of the KaHIP kaffpa session: 122 experiments, 69 hypotheses, 41 patches, 3.9x faster in total.

/plugin install aae --marketplace CHSZLab/AgenticAlgorithmEngineering /aae:aae make the solver in src/ faster on the graphs in data/ In Codex, install the skill with scripts/install_codex_skill.py and call it with $aae ; any other agent can follow AAE.md . To try it first, run the 10-minute quick-start example : a slow but correct shortest-path program with a benchmark and a correctness check.

Sessions share what they learned: the knowledge base collects optimization techniques and experiment results, and agents read it before they start. Contributions from your own sessions are welcome.

David A. Bader, Adil Chhabra, Ernestine Großmann, Monika Henzinger, Alexander Noe, and Christian Schulz. Agentic Algorithm Engineering: Improving Shared-Memory Exact Minimum Cuts. In 13th DIMACS Implementation Challenge Workshop: Network Flows 2.0, OASIcs, 2027. To appear. Preprint: arXiv:2609.07204 .

代理演算法工程 (AAE) 像演算法工程師一樣優化您的程式碼的代理：每次實驗前的可證偽假設、每次更改後檢查的正確性、每個接受的更改一個可審查的補丁以及整個會話的 PDF 報告。來自海德堡大學演算法工程小組的 Claude Code 和 Codex 技能。已建立的開源程式碼的結果每個保留的變更都會根據原始輸出進行檢查。工作原理：演算法工程週期 演算法工程是由可證偽假設驅動的設計、分析、實現和實驗的週期。 AAE 將此週期交給自主代理人。在設定過程中，您與代理商就基準、指標、正確性斷言和預算達成協議；然後它會自行運行。一個可證偽的假設：「改變 X 將使指標大致提高 Z，因為…」在測量之前透過剖析和分析來預測效果的方向和大小。提交給 Git 的最小更改，並檢查正確性斷言。運行基準測試；僅當更改更好且仍然正確時才保留更改，否則恢復。來自 KaHIP kaffpa 會議的報告：122 個實驗，69 個假設，41 個補丁，總共快了 3.9 倍。

/plugin install aae --marketplace CHSZLab/AgenticAlgorithmEngineering /aae:aae 使 src/ 中的解算器在 data/ 中的圖表上更快 在 Codex 中，使用 script/install_codex_skill.py 程式設計技能並使用 $aae 安裝技能；要先嘗試，請執行 10 分鐘的快速啟動範例：一個緩慢但正確的最短路徑程序，具有基準測試和正確性檢查。會議分享他們學到的知識：知識庫收集最佳化技術和實驗結果，代理人在開始之前閱讀它。歡迎您在自己的會議上做出貢獻。大衛·A·巴德、阿迪爾·恰布拉、歐內斯汀·格羅曼、莫妮卡·亨辛格、亞歷山大·諾伊和克里斯蒂安·舒爾茨。代理演算法工程：改進共享記憶體精確最小切割。在第 13 屆 DIMACS 實施挑戰研討會：網路流 2.0，OASIcs，2027 年。出現。預印本：arXiv:2609.07204。 @inproceedings{bader2027agenticalgorithmengineering，標題 = {代理演算法工程：改進共享記憶體精確最小切割}，作者 = {David A.

hn.originalTitle: Pizza history: AI agent's cardless purchase is a first for UK
hn.sourceOriginalText:
Comment 1: Seems like every new payment method gets inaugurated with a pizza (just ask Bitcoin)

Comment 2: Over the past week, I have been looking for an affordable handheld wood plane. So let's look at this quote: > the first step toward mass adoption by the public of a technology that would fundamentally change purchasing habits. ... This is possibly the last Black Friday as we know it I'm using ChatGPT, Sol 6.1. My requirements are fairly simple: a 45 degree blade, approx Stanley #5 style (so about 35cm long), I would prefer wooden handles but not required, must be affordable for a 'first' plane, not an expensive expert's tool, so sub-100-euros: find me one in a store I can order locally (Estonia, known for its online tech in general, you order everything online.) It turns out finding one that length at that price is hard. But the experience of AI-assisted shopping has been infuriating and frustrating. It kept circling back to other planes than my requirements. It frequently recommended s.

Comment 3: hand planes are a purchase that is highly impacted by preference. pizzas are not.

Comment 4: Or: pizzas can be customized. Hand planes cannot.

hn.sourceTextZh: 評論 1：似乎每一種新的支付方式都是以披薩開始的（只要問比特幣） 評論 2：在過去的一周裡，我一直在尋找一款價格實惠的手持木飛機。因此，讓我們來看看這句話： > 大眾大規模採用將從根本上改變購買習慣的技術的第一步。 ……據我們所知，這可能是最後一個黑色星期五，我正在使用 ChatGPT，Sol 6.1。我的要求相當簡單：45 度刀片，大約 Stanley #5 樣式（所以大約 35 厘米長），我更喜歡木柄，但不是必需的，必須是“第一架”飛機負擔得起的，而不是昂貴的專家工具，所以不到 100 歐元：在我可以在本地訂購的商店找到一個（愛沙尼亞，通常以其長度，通常在線上但人工智慧輔助購物的體驗卻令人憤怒和沮喪。它不斷地盤旋回到我要求以外的其他飛機上。它經常推薦 s。評論3：手持飛機是一種受偏好影響很大的購買行為。披薩不是。評論4：或者：披薩可以客製。手持飛機不能。
